name: Zuppa Toscana Soup
subtitle: Made by Lara
notes: Luke’s favorite soup in the world.

items: 1 lb spicy Italian ground sausage (can use reg pork sausage, add 1 tsp Italian seasoning and ¼ tsp cayenne (opt))

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.body: Chop **1 yellow onion**. Melt **1 Tbsp butter** in a pot, add onion and cook for 1–2 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: Add **1 Tbsp minced garlic** and **1 lb spicy Italian ground sausage**. Cook sausage until brown. Drain fat.

steps.title: Simmer the potatoes
steps.body: Add **6 cups chicken broth**, **1 cup water**, **4–5 yellow potatoes**, cut into 1-inch pieces, **2 tsp salt**, or to taste, and **1 tsp black pepper**. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish the soup
steps.body: Remove from heat and stir in **4 cups chopped kale**. Add **2 cups heavy cream**. Serve!
